rows.note: Use this colloquial wording when the person's age is the point; it usually means someone in their teens.

example.english: My son is a teenager now, so I don't need to follow him around all the time.
example.traditional: 我個仔都十幾歲人喇，唔使成日跟住佢。
example.jyutping: ngo5 go3 zai2 dou1 sap6 gei2 seoi3 jan4 laa3 m4 sai2 seng4 jat6 gan1 zyu6 keoi5

rows.note: Use this as the all-purpose noun for a teenager, especially in neutral contexts.

example.english: The government should pay more attention to every teenager's mental health.
example.traditional: 政府應該多啲關注每個青少年嘅心理健康。
example.jyutping: zing3 fu2 jing1 goi1 do1 di1 gwaan1 zyu3 mui5 go3 cing1 siu3 nin4 ge3 sam1 lei5 gin6 hong1
